basics.name: Mohamed Ehab Ahmed
basics.label: Data Scientist
basics.summary: My passion for problem-solving began in childhood when I discovered that a circle could minimize area in a puzzle challenge. That moment sparked my love for applied mathematics and creative thinking.
As I grew, I pursued Computer Science and explored how data is stored, processed, and analyzed to solve real-world problems. This deepened my interest in data-driven solutions.
Now, I am a budding Data Science student, dedicated to learning new tools, theories, and perspectives. I thrive on approaching challenges with creativity and mathematical rigor.
I am eager to contribute to innovative projects, collaborate with diverse teams, and continue growing in the field of Data Science.
